question: Who was the better scorer: Kobe in 2005-06 or Curry in 2015-16?

# Scoring Claim Review

## Answer

**My judgement: I lean toward Stephen Curry.**

**Criterion:** Evaluate scoring capability based on volume versus efficiency and relative scoring impact.

**Decisive reason:** Stephen Curry achieved an extraordinary level of efficiency, leading in Raw true shooting and Contemporaneous relative true shooting by wide margins, which outweighs Kobe Bryant's advantage in Accumulated points and Points per game. [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/playercareerstats?PlayerID=977&PerMode=Totals&LeagueID=00) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/playercareerstats?PlayerID=201939&PerMode=Totals&LeagueID=00) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/leaguegamelog?Counter=0&Direction=ASC&LeagueID=00&PlayerOrTeam=T&Season=2005-06&SeasonType=Regular+Season&Sorter=DATE&DateFrom=&DateTo=) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/leaguegamelog?Counter=0&Direction=ASC&LeagueID=00&PlayerOrTeam=T&Season=2015-16&SeasonType=Regular+Season&Sorter=DATE&DateFrom=&DateTo=)

**Strongest counterargument:** Kobe Bryant's higher Points per game and Accumulated points show a massive absolute scoring burden, but Stephen Curry's historic shooting efficiency and higher Contemporaneous relative true shooting make his scoring output more valuable relative to league context. [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/playercareerstats?PlayerID=977&PerMode=Totals&LeagueID=00) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/playercareerstats?PlayerID=201939&PerMode=Totals&LeagueID=00)

**Why this judgement:** Choosing between volume and efficiency involves weighing Kobe Bryant's massive scoring load against Stephen Curry's exceptional efficiency and relative spacing value.

**What could change it:** An extreme emphasis on raw scoring volume over efficiency could reverse the preference to Kobe Bryant.
Claim assessment: Conditional: the broad claim is not uniformly supported across the selected metrics.
**Regular Season: Kobe Bryant leads total points, points per game; Stephen Curry leads true shooting, league-relative efficiency.**
